description: Image Description: The image features a tall clock tower set against a clear blue sky. The tower is constructed with a combination of materials, including red brick for the lower section and white stone or concrete for the upper portion. The base of the tower is made of red brick, with horizontal lines suggesting structural divisions or decorative elements. Above this, the white upper section includes an open belfry with arched openings, through which several bells are visible. The belfry is topped with a pointed roof
